description: The error and warning codes of mixedcheck, shared by the R and Python packages. docs/spec/errors.md describes the format, the rendering of templates and the reporting rules. Codes are never renumbered or reused.

areas.title: Input files and bytes
areas.description: Files that cannot be opened and inputs that start with a byte-order mark, for every reader.

areas.title: JSON reading
areas.description: The syntax of JSON text and the rules of the strict reader on keys, surrogates, literals, numbers and nesting (conventions.md, Strict reader).

areas.title: JSON profiles
areas.description: The rules of the hashable and data profiles, applied by readers and writers (conventions.md, Profiles).

areas.title: Unicode
areas.description: UTF-8 validity, NFC, encoding marks in R and surrogates in Python (conventions.md, Text and Unicode).

areas.title: Canonical serialisation
areas.description: In-memory values that have no JSON form (conventions.md, Serialisation).

areas.title: Hashes and keyed commitments
areas.description: Commitment keys, commitments and recorded hashes (conventions.md, Hashes and Keyed commitments).

areas.title: Structural validation
areas.description: Violations of the JSON Schema keywords of a document schema and unsupported document versions, shared by every document validator (errors.md, Structural validation).

areas.title: Declarations
areas.description: Rules of declaration vocabulary 0.1 that the validators enforce in code, including the table block.

areas.title: YAML authoring
areas.description: Reading YAML sources with every scalar as a string and converting them to JSON (conventions.md, YAML authoring).

areas.title: Registry
areas.description: Registry sources, the compiler and loading of the compiled registry.

areas.title: Data tables
areas.description: Reading data tables against the declared table block (tables.md).

areas.title: Formulas and the IR
areas.description: The formula grammar, term expansion, the building of the canonical IR and its design matrices, and IR documents (ir.md).

areas.title: Results documents
areas.description: Results documents, their access log section and the internal sidecar.

areas.title: Internal errors
areas.description: Failed internal checks, which indicate a bug.
